SalonBackup.title: SalonBackup
SalonBackup.description: Cloud backup of salon appointments, transactions, staff, customers, and settings owned by the authenticated manager.

ownerId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google manager account.

payloadJson.description: Serialized JSON string of salon state.

updatedAt.description: Human readable timestamp of last backup.

/salonBackups/{userId}.description: Per-manager cloud backup document keyed by the authenticated user's UID.
